corrections.topic: SEVIRI Viewing Geometry & Optical Product Boundaries
corrections.ai_claim: GPT claimed SEVIRI MSG covers Scandinavia with high quality, and initial audit claimed NWC SAF explicitly disables optical retrievals north of 65N.
corrections.hardened_correction: Sub-satellite geometry (0°N, 0°E vs 68.36°N, 18.74°E) yields a calculated Satellite Viewing Zenith Angle VZA ≈ 76.54° at Nuolja, inducing calculated geometric pixel enlargement (>12.9 km N-S footprint) and horizontal parallax shifts (>20.9 km for 5 km cloud tops). High VZA (>75°) causes severe geometric foreshortening and degraded optical retrieval quality at polar latitudes. Solar optical channels (COT/CER) are unavailable during polar night (SZA > 84°), though thermal IR and cloud phase remain available year-round.

corrections.topic: Satellite Cloud Motion Vectors & Stage 8.5 Scope
corrections.ai_claim: Initial audit claimed Stage 8.5 physically invalidated satellite cloud-motion vectors.
corrections.hardened_correction: Stage 8.5 tested MEPS spatial cloud/advection features across a 9-grid neighborhood and rejected their predictive augmentation under the EVEN-CV protocol. This rejection applies specifically to the tested MEPS spatial advection features and cannot by itself be generalized to prove all satellite cloud-motion methods are physically invalid. Existing POLARIS evidence does not establish a sufficiently novel, causally available, and operationally representative satellite cloud-motion route for the current benchmark.

corrections.ai_claim: Initial audit implied satellite cloud information is entirely unavailable during polar night.
corrections.hardened_correction: Stage 8.4 verified 225/347 usable origins (64.84% empirical coverage) for Suomi-NPP and NOAA-20 VIIRS L2 cloud products. Physical acquisition causality (t_acq <= t0) is satisfied for 346/347 origins, but standard science L2 products suffer a 3-13h publication latency (t_pub > t0). Solar optical products (COT/CER) are unavailable during polar night (SZA > 84°), but thermal IR brightness temperatures and cloud phase remain available year-round.

corrections.ai_claim: Initial audit stated as universal fact that satellite ML nowcasters only work for H1-H3 or necessarily degrade below NWP at H4-H24.
corrections.hardened_correction: Available candidate ML cloud-nowcasting products were not verified to provide a causally available, 2024-reconstructable operational product covering the full H1-H24 benchmark horizon at Nuolja.
